name: Fleeting Arc through Heaven and Earth
text: You swing your weapon in a wide arc, releasing a blazing rainbow that deals 9d6 spirit damage and 9d6 untyped damage of the same type as your weapon to all enemies in a 60-foot cone, with a basic Fortitude save save against your class DC. As the rainbow ripples out, you use it as a bridge to teleport to any location within the effect's area.
